page.title: Account groups
page.description: Organize accounts into groups. Bank connections create and manage their own groups automatically.

empty.title: No account groups yet
empty.description: Group accounts by bank, currency or purpose to keep your accounts list tidy.

loadError.title: Couldn't load your groups
loadError.description: Something went wrong while fetching your account groups. Check your connection and try again.

row.bankBadgeTooltip: This group was created when you connected the bank, but it doesn't represent the connection itself — you're free to rename it, move accounts, or delete it. Accounts will stay synced regardless.
row.accountsElsewhere: {count} synced account in other groups | {count} synced accounts in other groups

accounts.removeConfirmDescription: The account isn't deleted — it only leaves this group.

delete.accountsKept: Accounts are kept — they simply become ungrouped.
delete.syncContinues: Bank syncing continues — the connection is separate from this group.

rename.title: Rename group
rename.description: Click the logo to pick a bank logo, initials or a color.

move.title: Move “{name}”
move.description: Its subgroups and accounts move with it.
move.hint: Pick “No parent” to make it a top-level group.

addAccounts.title: Add accounts to “{name}”
addAccounts.description: An account belongs to one group. Picking one from another group moves it here.

summary.movesFromGroup: {selected} selected, {count} move from {group} | {selected} selected, {count} moves from {group}
summary.movesFromOtherGroups: {selected} selected, {count} move from other groups | {selected} selected, {count} moves from other groups

organize.hint: Drag a group onto another to nest it
organize.dropToTopLevel: Drop here to make “{name}” a top-level group
organize.saveFailed: Couldn't save {count} move. Try again. | Couldn't save {count} moves. Try again.
organize.staleMovesRemoved: Removed {count} queued move that no longer applies | Removed {count} queued moves that no longer apply

dropErrors.insideItself: Can't move a group inside its own subgroup
